articles.headline: Gary Neville slams Argentina: 'Without Messi, they'd struggle to get to the semifinals'
articles.description: Gary Neville has sharply criticised Argentina's style of play in the World Cup final against Spain and is the latest pundit to slam Lionel Scaloni's men for their tactics.

articles.headline: Argentina, without Lionel Messi, greeted by fans in Buenos Aires after World Cup return
articles.description: Thousands of fans gathered in Buenos Aires on Monday evening to give a warm welcome to the Argentina football squad, who arrived home without captain Lionel Messi after their World Cup final loss to Spain.

articles.headline: Alex Baena makes history with World Cup triumph, becomes first player to achieve unique feat
articles.description: Álex Baena has made history, becoming the first player to win the Euros, Olympic Games and World Cup back-to-back.

articles.headline: Grading the 2026 World Cup from Spain's A to Infantino's F
articles.description: The World Cup is officially over and it's time to provide some final grades to some of the teams and people who became household names in North America.

articles.headline: How will 2026 World Cup be remembered: Messi? Haaland? Cape Verde? Trump?
articles.description: Every World Cup has one enduring legacy. 2022 was Messi's win. 2018 was Mbappe's breakout. What will 2026 be remembered for?

articles.headline: CONMEBOL president says the next World Cup will have 64 teams
articles.description: The president of CONMEBOL has said on social media that the 2030 World Cup will be a "64-team tournament."
